claude.result:
Ran the lagged CUTI/BEUTI-vs-ypa correlation I'd flagged as outstanding (n=460, lags 0/7/10/14): all essentially zero — the core upwelling thesis isn't supported as a linear signal at any lag, while raw SST level shows a modest real correlation (0.21-0.25) but is likely just seasonal-cycle tracking. Also found a season-to-season divergence: S1's doy180-213 "slump" in overnight/day_1_5 didn't repeat in S2 (those classes woke up to 0.2-0.65 ypa this window while S1 was flat ~0.01-0.04), which we couldn't act on since spring overspend had already capped budget at $120.

Updated `notes.md` with both findings and revised the S3 priority list: drop CUTI/BEUTI as a signal, move the hard budget-reserve cutoff for overnight/day_1_5 capacity from doy260 up to doy180-190, and keep treating "which window is dead vs live" as something to re-check per season rather than assume from prior-season climatology (except HD_AM/HD_PM staying dead doy154-300, which held in both seasons). Rest-of-S2 plan stays as-is: hold cash/PTO, spend only on a confirmed live $80 HD boat.
